cross_verification.note_en: Royal Oman Police (ROP) issues Omani passports through 'e_passport.aspx', a transactional e-government portal (PKI e-authentication, in-Sultanate presence required) rather than a public information page — direct fetch of it and of the general Civil Status & Passport services page returned only procedural/eligibility text, no photo composition specs. Numerous third-party photo-service sites claim a 4x6cm size with 38mm head height on a blue background, and Oman's separate eVisa service (evisa.rop.gov.om, a different ROP unit — see om-visa.json) does publish official photo rules, but per the truth-gate instructions neither the vendor claims nor the eVisa rules (a distinct document type) were used to fill in passport-specific fields here, since no rop.gov.om page could be found that states them for the physical passport itself.
